# Claude tools

46 tools that Claude calls to edit a video. They are defined in [src/claude/tools.ts](../../src/claude/tools.ts) and exposed with `toAnthropicTools()` in Messages API format. Run them with `executeTool(session, name, input)`. Inputs are validated against the schemas below, and errors come back as `isError` results instead of exceptions.

Tools marked **edits** change the project, record an undo step and notify the live preview. Tools marked **read-only** only inspect or render.

## Contents

- **Inspect & project**: [get_project](#get_project), [new_project](#new_project), [set_project_settings](#set_project_settings), [undo](#undo), [redo](#redo)
- **Library**: [list_templates](#list_templates), [get_template](#get_template), [apply_template](#apply_template), [list_effects](#list_effects), [list_transitions](#list_transitions), [list_animations](#list_animations), [list_caption_styles](#list_caption_styles), [list_components](#list_components)
- **Media & primary track**: [import_media](#import_media), [add_clip](#add_clip), [update_clip](#update_clip), [remove_clip](#remove_clip), [move_clip](#move_clip), [split_clip](#split_clip), [trim_clip](#trim_clip), [set_transition](#set_transition), [add_effect](#add_effect), [remove_effect](#remove_effect)
- **Layers**: [add_text](#add_text), [add_media_overlay](#add_media_overlay), [add_shape](#add_shape), [add_component](#add_component), [update_layer](#update_layer), [remove_layer](#remove_layer)
- **Audio**: [add_audio](#add_audio), [update_audio](#update_audio), [remove_audio](#remove_audio)
- **Transcript & captions**: [transcribe](#transcribe), [set_transcript](#set_transcript), [get_transcript](#get_transcript), [search_transcript](#search_transcript), [cleanup_speech](#cleanup_speech), [cut_ranges](#cut_ranges), [assemble_from_source](#assemble_from_source), [set_captions](#set_captions), [export_captions](#export_captions)
- **Voice-over**: [generate_voiceover](#generate_voiceover)
- **Preview & render**: [render_frame](#render_frame), [render_contact_sheet](#render_contact_sheet), [render_preview](#render_preview), [render_video](#render_video)

## Inspect & project

### get_project

**read-only**. Get a readable summary of the current edit (assets, clips with timeline times, layers, audio, captions) plus validation issues. Call this first and whenever you need to re-orient.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `includeJson` | boolean |  | `false` | Also return the raw project JSON |

### new_project

**edits**. Start a new empty project (discarding the current one; undo restores it).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | `"Untitled"` |  |
| `aspectRatio` | "9:16" \| "16:9" \| "1:1" \| "4:5" \| "21:9" |  | `"9:16"` |  |
| `fps` | number |  | `30` |  |

### set_project_settings

**edits**. Change resolution/aspect ratio, frame rate, background color or name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aspectRatio` | "9:16" \| "16:9" \| "1:1" \| "4:5" \| "21:9" |  |  |  |
| `width` | integer |  |  | (≥ -9007199254740991) |
| `height` | integer |  |  | (≥ -9007199254740991) |
| `fps` | number |  |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | string |  |  |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |  |

### undo

**edits**. Undo the last edit.

_No parameters._

### redo

**edits**. Redo the last undone edit.

_No parameters._

## Library

### list_templates

**read-only**. Browse video templates (styles to edit toward). Filter by category, aspect ratio or a search query like 'podcast' or 'real estate'.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | "social" \| "youtube" \| "business" \| "education" \| "personal" \| "promo" \| "entertainment" |  |  |  |
| `aspectRatio` | "9:16" \| "16:9" \| "1:1" \| "4:5" \| "21:9" |  |  |  |
| `query` | string |  |  |  |

### get_template

**read-only**. Read a template's brief: required inputs (slots), scenes, look, and guidance on how to edit footage to match it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `includeSpec` | boolean |  | `false` | Also return the full JSON spec |

### apply_template

**edits**. Build a new edit from a template and inputs (replaces the current project; undo restores it). Inputs map slot ids to values: text slots take strings; media slots take a path or {src, in, duration}; list slots take arrays of objects using the listed fields. Media are probed automatically. Transcripts already set on imported assets with the same src are reused for captions.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `inputs` | object | yes |  |  |
| `aspectRatio` | "9:16" \| "16:9" \| "1:1" \| "4:5" \| "21:9" |  |  | Override the template's aspect ratio |
| `theme` | object |  |  | Theme overrides, e.g. {accentColor: '#FF0000'} |

### list_effects

**read-only**. List available visual effects (color grades, blur, zoom/motion, stylize) with their parameters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | "color" \| "grade" \| "blur" \| "stylize" \| "motion" \| "distort" \| "time" |  |  |  |

### list_transitions

**read-only**. List transitions usable between primary-track clips.

_No parameters._

### list_animations

**read-only**. List entrance/exit animations for text, shape and media layers.

_No parameters._

### list_caption_styles

**read-only**. List caption style presets (bold-pop, karaoke, word-by-word, boxed, cinematic…).

_No parameters._

### list_components

**read-only**. List reusable components (lower-third, title-card, CTA, subscribe button, quote, number badge, countdown…) and their params.

_No parameters._

## Media & primary track

### import_media

**edits**. Add a video, audio or image file to the project's assets (probes duration, size and audio). Returns the asset id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | yes |  | File path or URL |
| `id` | string |  |  |  |
| `label` | string |  |  |  |

### add_clip

**edits**. Add a clip to the primary track (clips play back-to-back). Use `in`/`duration` (source seconds) to trim. Images/colors need a duration.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `in` | number |  |  | (≥ 0) |
| `duration` | number |  |  | (> 0) |
| `index` | integer |  |  | Insert position (default: end) (≥ 0) |
| `speed` | number |  |  |  |
| `fit` | "cover" \| "contain" \| "stretch" \| "blur" |  |  | cover = fill & crop, contain = letterbox, stretch = distort, blur = contain over blurred copy |
| `volume` | number |  |  |  |
| `muted` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `transition` | { type, duration } |  |  | Transition into this clip |
| `transition.type` | string | yes |  | Transition id from the transitions catalog, e.g. 'fade', 'slideleft' |
| `transition.duration` | number |  | `0.5` | (> 0, ≤ 5) |
| `effects` | { type, params }[] |  |  |  |

## Audio

### add_audio

**edits**. Add music, voice-over or a sound effect. Music is ducked under speech by default; loop=true repeats it to the end of the video.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `role` | "music" \| "voiceover" \| "sfx" |  | `"music"` |  |
| `start` | number |  | `0` | (≥ 0) |
| `in` | number |  |  | (≥ 0) |
| `duration` | number |  |  | (> 0) |
| `volume` | number |  |  | (≥ 0, ≤ 4) |
| `fadeIn` | number |  |  | (≥ 0) |
| `fadeOut` | number |  |  | (≥ 0) |
| `loop` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `duck` | boolean |  |  |  |

## Transcript & captions

### transcribe

**edits**. Transcribe an asset's speech with word timings (needs a transcription provider). Enables captions, search and filler removal.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `language` | string |  |  |  |

### set_transcript

**edits**. Attach a transcript to an asset from SRT, VTT, Whisper/Deepgram/AssemblyAI JSON, or {words:[{text,start,end}]}. Times are in source seconds.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `content` | string \| object | yes |  |  |
| `format` | "srt" \| "vtt" \| "whisper" \| "deepgram" \| "assemblyai" \| "transcript" |  |  |  |

### get_transcript

**read-only**. Read an asset's transcript as timestamped sentences (source time) with speaking stats.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |

### search_transcript

**read-only**. Find where a phrase is said. Returns source times and, if that part is in the edit, timeline times.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  |  |
| `assetId` | string |  |  |  |

### cleanup_speech

**edits**. Tighten talking-head footage using its transcript: cut filler words (um, uh…), stutters and long pauses. Layers and audio shift to stay in sync.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `fillers` | boolean \| string[] |  | `true` | true = default list, or a custom list (e.g. add 'like', 'you know') |
| `repetitions` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `maxPause` | number |  | `0.6` | Pauses longer than this are shortened (> 0) |
| `keepPause` | number |  | `0.2` | Pause left behind (≥ 0) |

### cut_ranges

**edits**. Remove time ranges from the finished timeline (timeline seconds). Everything after each cut moves earlier.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ranges` | { start, end }[] | yes |  |  |

### assemble_from_source

**edits**. Rebuild the primary track from chosen source ranges of one asset, in the order given (e.g. pick the best moments of a long recording by transcript).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assetId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `ranges` | { start, end }[] | yes |  |  |
| `transition` | { type, duration } |  |  |  |
| `transition.type` | string | yes |  | Transition id from the transitions catalog, e.g. 'fade', 'slideleft' |
| `transition.duration` | number |  | `0.5` | (> 0, ≤ 5) |
| `fit` | "cover" \| "contain" \| "stretch" \| "blur" |  |  | cover = fill & crop, contain = letterbox, stretch = distort, blur = contain over blurred copy |

### set_captions

**edits**. Turn captions on/off and pick a style (see list_caption_styles). Captions come from transcripts and stay synced through edits. Override style fields like position (0-1), fontSize, highlightColor, uppercase, maxWordsPerLine.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `style` | string |  |  |  |
| `overrides` | object |  |  |  |
| `segments` | { text, start, end }[] |  |  | Manual captions in timeline seconds (instead of transcripts) |

### export_captions

**read-only**. Write the captions as a subtitle sidecar file (srt, vtt or ass), e.g. for YouTube upload.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | "srt" \| "vtt" \| "ass" |  | `"srt"` |  |
| `output` | string |  |  |  |

## Preview & render

### render_frame

**read-only**. Render one frame of the edit at a timeline time and look at it. Use to check layout, text, captions and effects.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | number | yes |  | (≥ 0) |
| `scale` | number |  | `0.5` | (≥ 0.1, ≤ 1) |

### render_contact_sheet

**read-only**. Render a grid of frames sampled across the whole video, a one-image overview of the edit's pacing and look.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | integer |  | `4` | (≥ 1, ≤ 8) |
| `rows` | integer |  | `3` | (≥ 1, ≤ 8) |
| `thumbWidth` | integer |  | `320` | (≥ -9007199254740991) |

### render_preview

**read-only**. Render a fast low-resolution preview video (shown in the live preview for the user). Optionally only a time range.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | number |  | `0.5` | (≥ 0.1, ≤ 1) |
| `start` | number |  |  | (≥ 0) |
| `end` | number |  |  | (> 0) |

### render_video

**read-only**. Render the final full-quality video file.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output` | string | yes |  | Output path, e.g. out/final.mp4 |
